profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer at HP focused on building scalable, secure enterprise solutions. I value collaboration, clear communication, and solving complex problems that make systems more reliable and impactful. 

My path into software engineering is grounded in a diverse background. Earlier in my career, I spent six years at Amgen in Quality Assurance, developing a strong foundation in regulatory compliance and quality-driven thinking. I later earned a second bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from Colorado State University to transition fully into software engineering. 

I consider myself a self-motivated leader and lifelong learner who values continuous improvement. 

Outside of work, I enjoy the outdoors, music, and fitness—I once trained for a 50-mile trail race, a challenge that taught me much about persistence and the benefits of a long-term mindset.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
At HP, I have played a pivotal role in developing innovative, scalable, and secure software solutions for IT management customers. 

I led the design and implementation of database integration and Revenera-based licensing solutions in a startup project, eventually bringing my experience to HP Anyware, an enterprise SAAS software solution, where I have focused on a remoting software component that delivers session telemetry, CPU and GPU metrics, and other tasks over HTTP and MQTT communication protocols. 
 
I am experienced with .NET, C#, HiveMQ, OAuth, NHibernate, and Flexera-SDKs. I have proficiency in python, docker, and kubernetes development environments, as well as use of DataDog and other observability tools.  
 
I am currently on the exciting fast path of learning how use and govern Agentic AI development tools to optimize efficiency in development.
positions.insights: Skills: SaaS Development · OAuth · Scrum · Web Services · Software Observability · GitHub Copilot · Databases · Software Development · Mqtt · .NET Framework · Agile Application Development

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assist teaching Java Programming Foundational Concepts

positions.title: Quality Analytical Laboratory Associate
positions.description: In my role at Amgen, I was integral to maintaining high-quality standards in biochemistry laboratory operations through rigorous testing and procedural revisions. I actively participated in non-conformance investigations and trained colleagues on cGMP-compliant analytical methods, ensuring our team consistently met regulatory requirements. My contributions supported product development and enhanced laboratory efficiency.

positions.title: Manufacturing Associate
positions.description: In my first year at Amgen, I developed my skills in manufacturing operations, focusing on Buffer Prep, Cell Culture, and Purification. My role involved leading the buffer prep area, coordinating with plant leads to meet deadlines, and ensuring compliance with cGMP and USP standards.
